name: after-build-quiz
description: Quizzes you on your own commits so you learn from what gets built.

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Where the queue and quiz log live. Empty means %USERPROFILE%\.after-build-quiz. Must not be inside a git repo.

minChangedLines.title: Minimum changed code lines
minChangedLines.description: Commits with fewer added+deleted code lines (whitespace ignored) are not queued.

queueCap.title: Pending quiz cap
queueCap.description: Most recent pending commits kept; older ones expire.

model.title: Quiz model
model.description: Model that writes the questions and grades the answers.
